column2: when a free object is being
slub_debug poisons the object data before KASAN

column3: KASAN only initializes the alloc metadata

column1: which is always stored outside of the object.  slub_debug is aware of this
and it skips poisoning and checking that memory area.

column2: with the following patch in this series

column1: initializing its free medata in setup_object.  As this metadata might be
slub_debug poisoning.  This leads to slub_debug reports.

column2: skip checking slub_debug poisoning of the object data area that

column1: overlaps with the in-object KASAN free metadata.
